items.title: Eddie Locke interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, NY, January 13, 2001
items.q: And like as Papa Jo said, take care of the bandstand. ... Jo did say “you’ve got to know how to get on the stage, you’ve got to know how to get off the stage.”

ctx.x: Well he was like my — I don’t know what to call him. I had a great relationship with him and Coleman, but both of the relationships were very different. And Roy Eldridge was the Godfather of my children, you know it was like my family you know. And those guys, they never — you know what I really loved about them? They never, ever BS’d me about what I could do. Do you know? He’d say “you’re not great but you’re okay. You just keep doing what you’re doing. You’re all right.” You know they didn’t put that stuff in…
